system.description: Each time you kill a living opponent, regain Stamina equal to half your Arcane Might. At Arcane Might II or greater once per scene, immediately after killing an opponent with a melee attack you may perform another melee attack before the end of your turn as if you still had a primary action. At Arcane Might IV, you may benefit from this once per turn, at Arcane Might VI you may perform an extra melee attack action after each kill.
